audience: freelancers and agencies that track billable hours for clients in Timeneye

useCases.title: Log time on a project for a day
useCases.text: Find the project and phase ids first. Then create a time entry with minutes, date, project and phase.

useCases.title: List the unbilled time for a client
useCases.text: Find the client, then list its time entries for a period, filtered by billing status. Open one entry to read its notes.

useCases.title: Compare logged time with project budgets
useCases.text: Read projects with their billable flag and budget fields. Read the time entries of one project for the month.

useCases.title: Check planned hours and time-off requests
useCases.text: List the planned hours per person and project. List the time-off requests in a date range.
